candidates.change_summary: Remove the owner requirement by replacing require(msg.sender == owner) with require(msg.sender != owner), allowing only non-owners to call sendTo and thus changing who can cause transfers.
Replace the non-zero receiver check with allow zero address (remove require(receiver != address(0))) so transfers to the zero address are permitted, changing post-call observable behavior.
Relax the positive amount check by changing require(amount > 0) to require(amount >= 0), allowing zero-value transfers to be executed successfully.
Swap the order of checks and transfer so the transfer is attempted before the require(amount > 0), which may change observable behavior when transfer reverts or when amount == 0.
Insert an additional owner transfer guard that requires owner to be non-zero address, which can cause different revert behavior if owner is zero.
